name: Baylor Harrison
headline: AI & Software Engineer | Founder, Manifold Engineering
summary: Builds AI applications, machine-learning services and cloud systems that connect business knowledge, automate workflows and make information useful. Combines hands-on engineering with project direction and delivery.

The dashboard and the ChatGPT connection are live; the daily export is being proven run by run.
